bound: one-sided KL-Chernoff bound for iid [0,1] episode losses
multiplicity: Bonferroni across 6 scenarios x 5 candidate weights
mobility_population: uniform empirical mixture of the six R73 preregistered GeoLife weeks
window_selector: first eight bytes of SHA-256('R75-window|' + decimal seed), modulo six
decision_cost_basis: design-side fee; execution settlement separately reported
selection: smallest g whose simultaneous upper bound is <= 0.005 in every scenario; otherwise structural fallback g=1
test_profiles: selected g, g=0.25 comparator, and g=1 structural reference, deduplicated
status_semantics_amendment: top-level status=failed with execution_status=completed is an observed QoS loss and remains in the risk sample; only incomplete execution is a computational failure
claim_scope: conditional on the fixed six-week empirical mobility mixture and modeled economic/random response generator
